text: This week, Zenaida Carol Snow's (ZCS0012) email activity triggered rule R3, indicating an unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients. The evidence for this anomaly is the 54.57 MB of email attachments sent, which is significantly higher than her typical range of 23.37 MB. Additionally, there were 61 external email recipients, which is within her usual range but still noteworthy given the high volume of attachment data.
